name: mdx-marketplace-skill-library-contract
human_line: Turn a run your team already proved into a reusable procedure your agents can lean on - drafted from the trajectory, promoted by a person, cited like a lesson.
why: Executable skill libraries are the largest compounding mechanism in the agent-memory literature (Voyager, AWM, ReasoningBank). MDx ships the governed, receipted version: every step of the promotion carries a hash-chained receipt.

writes.requires: a proven-green source run: a forge.run.event run_finished stamped RUN_FINISHED_DONE whose run also emitted a check_passed event
writes.procedure: assembled deterministically from the run's own trajectory events; a model pass may sharpen the prose only behind a claim guard, with the deterministic floor always stored beside it
writes.boundary_lock: a sensitive skill is boundary-locked so reuse never injects it into a run whose applicability does not explicitly name it

writes.requires: a distinct actor from the drafter, citing the drafted receipt
writes.effect: promotes the draft into a distilled_skill origin in the capability registry, carrying the full chain source_run -> draft -> ratification

provenance_chain_rule: A ratified skill MUST cite a drafted skill, which MUST cite a proven-green source run. Fail-closed: no orphan skills.

reuse.effect: a matching ratified distilled procedure is injected into the run context as an available procedure and cited on a run event, exactly like an advisory lesson
